issues.title: Broken External Spec References (AC-24)
issues.why: AC-22 and AC-23 rely on external modules (spec/05, spec/27) for critical resilience and DB logic which are not provided in this context.
issues.fix: Incorporate the normative content of AC-SD-22 and AC-T-28 directly into a 'Shared Infrastructure' section within this module.

issues.title: Inconsistent Function Length Constraints
issues.why: AC-11 mandates functions ≤ 50 lines, but 08-code-style.md mandates a much stricter 8–15 lines.
issues.fix: Standardize on ≤ 50 lines in 08-code-style.md to match the AC-11 master contract.

issues.title: Missing Timeout/Deadline Contract for Network Ops
issues.why: While DB concurrency is addressed in AC-22, network timeouts (HTTP/Clone) are mentioned in AC-15 but lack a specific duration or retry policy.
issues.fix: Add a 'Network Resilience' AC specifying a 30s default timeout and 3-attempt retry policy for all external calls.
